description: This guide provides definitive, opinionated best practices for building robust, performant, maintainable cross-platform mobile apps with Expo + modern React Native patterns and latest SDK features. Adhere to ensure consistency, performance, maintainability. Maintain clean, scalable project structure: `assets/` static assets; `src/` app logic; `src/components/` reusable UI; `src/screens/` distinct app views; `src/navigation/` navigation config (if not using Expo Router’s `app/`); `src/hooks/` custom hooks; `src/utils/` utilities/constants; `src/services/` API clients/data fetching. Naming: dirs `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; variables/functions `camelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Prefer functional components + TypeScript + clear styling.

**Functional Components with Hooks:** Always use functional components. `class MyComponent extends React.Component { /* ... */ }` ❌ BAD `const MyComponent: React.FC = () => { /* ... */ };`. **TypeScript:** All new code must be in TypeScript. `function greet(name) { return \`Hello, ${name}\`; }` `const greet = (name: string): string => \`Hello, ${name}\`;` **Styling:** Centralize styles with `StyleSheet`. `Text` with inline style example + `StyleSheet` example as shown.

Routing: Use file-based routing with `app/`. ❌ BAD Manual stack/tab navigator setup in a single file for all routes. (Show `app/_layout.tsx`, `app/index.tsx`, `app/profile/[id].tsx` + `useLocalSearchParams
